token.hideTip: A hidden token is seen by the DM and its owner only; players do not see it on the map or in the initiative.

tool.selectTip: Select and drag tokens. Drop within your movement to move; the DM can place anywhere.
tool.panTip: Drag the map. Wheel to zoom, double-click to fit.
tool.fogRevealTip: Draw a rectangle to reveal it to the players.
tool.fogHideTip: Draw a rectangle to cover it again.

fog.coverAllTip: Covers the whole map again; players see only their own tokens. Undoable.
fog.offTip: Removes the fog: the players see the whole map.

view.playerTip: See the map as the players see it: no hidden tokens, fog fully opaque.

scale.tip: Each square is 5 feet; distance counts every step the same, diagonals included (D&D 2024).
